audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 1 - the planar evil families round of the Monster Manual II arc (the user Go call on the landed letters BC). The pin-time walk from the print finds TWENTY-NINE entries on pp. 28-42: nine daemons (the arcanadaemon through the yagnodaemon), three demodands (the farastu through the shator), thirteen demons (the alu-demon through the rutterkin) and four singletons (the dao, the crimson death, the demilich, the derro). TWENTY-NINE defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema - no form splits in D part 1. THE GRIDS: the 29-row DpStats stat grid (every armor class, hit-dice, hit, xp and lair cell of the stat blocks) and the 12-row cambion parentage grid (the Major and Baron/Marquis columns of the Male Parentage Class table). NO GAP FLIPS (the Letter D box flips only when all D parts land - the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH (mm2_print rides the allowed-source list since R797). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 29 defs against the DpStats grid, the dao plane, the xpValue formula, the cambion parentage cells, the derro sentinel and the registry census floor 534 -> 563.

banner.title: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 1 - the twenty-nine planar evil entries of the letter D opening (the daemons, the demodands and the demons, pp. 28-42 through the derro), promoted to the live registry
banner.provenance: Round three of the MM2 arc, the first PART-LETTER walk (the user Go call on the landed letters BC: the letter D is too large for one round, so part 1 takes the planar evil families pp. 28-42 and the rest of D awaits the user call). The capture is the Curtiss PDF upload cross-checked against an independent transcription and the archive.org djvu OCR, the contested cells settled: the kelubar LEVEL/X.P. keeps the print 3959 (the ladder would say 3950) and its % IN LAIR cell prints BLANK (all three sources); the cambion xp prints 4400 in the block and 4409 in the parentage table (a genuine print-internal inconsistency pinning as it prints; the grid rides the block Minor 1275 + 10/hp); the shator weapon strength bonus reads +9 (the capture +8 is an OCR misread; the giant ladder 21 reads +9); the graz'zt DAMAGE/ATTACK prints By weapon type 6 verbatim (no plus); the alu-demon range VIII or IX/3000 or 4050 + 14/hp pins its low end; the yagnodaemon SIZE is L; the dao SIZE keeps its capture-primary double-primes; the hydrodaemon treasure prints I,Y; the chasme LEVEL prints VIII; the nabassu first claw reads 2-8/2-8/3-12; the babau attack/defense modes read A,C,E/F,G,H; the arcanadaemon INTELLIGENCE reads Supra-genius; the demilich ARMOR CLASS prints -6 and special so the def carries the bare -6 (the sign-drop class); the derro LEVEL/X.P. prints Variables preclude a fixed number so the def carries the xp 0 sentinel (the Amaimon precedent); the farastu Nil (25%) and shator Nil (40%) lair parentheticals and the hydrodaemon 90%-near-Styx parenthetical ride the pins. The pin-time walk finds nine daemon entries (the arcanadaemon through the yagnodaemon), three demodands (the farastu through the shator), thirteen demons (the alu-demon through the rutterkin) and four singletons (the dao, the crimson death, the demilich, the derro); twenty-nine .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 491+43 -> 534 -> 563 (the landed letters A and BC floors stay floors). The stat blocks pin in the 29-row DpStats grid; the cambion Male Parentage Class table pins as the 12-row parentage grid; the daemon, demodand and demon common doctrine (the attack-form charts, the magic-resistance decrement rule, the demodand summon-cap ladder, the name-speaking base, the 45-name Abyss ruler enumeration and the 28-line inhabitants roster) pins as round-level doctrine. NO GAP FLIPS: the Letter D box flips only when all the D parts land (the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH: mm2_print already rides the allowed-source list (the R797 patch). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 29 defs against the DpStats grid, the planes, the xpValue formula, the cambion parentage cells, the derro sentinel and the registry census 534 -> 563 as a floor.

col_comments: The ARMOR CLASS cell (the charon, oinodaemon, demilich, farastu, kelubar, shator, babau, baphomet, bar-lgura, chasme, fraz-urb'luu, graz'zt, kostchtchie and pazuzu negatives ride bare Lua numbers - a string drops the sign; the demilich -6 and the cambion 6 are settled reads, the print strings ride the defs)
The HIT DICE number (the flat-hp forms read 0 - the loader flat-hp path; the alu 6+2 pins the range low end)
The HIT DICE bonus points (the alu 6+2 to 6+6 pins the +2)
The average hit points (floor of dice x 3.5 plus bonus; the flat-hp forms carry the print value)
The NO. OF ATTACKS (the loader or-rule reads the max: the babau 1 or 3 reads 3, graz'zt 2 or 4 reads 4; the fraz-urb'luu 3 and 1 sums to 4; the demilich Special reads 1)
The LEVEL/X.P. base value (the kelubar 3959 print verbatim; the cambion 1275 is the block Minor line; the derro 0 is the Variables sentinel)
The xp per hit point (the charon 35, the oinodaemon/baphomet/fraz-urb'luu/graz'zt/kostchtchie/pazuzu 0 flat-form cells)
The % IN LAIR cell (Nil reads 0; the kelubar cell prints BLANK; the farastu Nil (25%) and shator Nil (40%) parentheticals ride the pins)
The primary MOVE rate in inches (the first range reads its low end; the demilich Special reads 0)
